primary_sources.title: Quadratic reciprocity and the sign of the Gauss sum via the finite Weil representation

locations.matched_content: Positive unnormalized DFT equals C_N times the source Weyl-element operator.

primary_sources.coefficient_domain: Complex representations over the finite ring Z/NZ for odd N; this comparison specializes to odd prime length.
caveats: C_N=i^((N-1)/2)*sqrt(N) is tied to the standard additive character.
The introduction displays the inverse Weyl matrix; Section 2.2 and Theorem 2.4 agree with the positive DFT and stated Schrodinger action.
Composite length does not inherit the rank 1/N dichotomy.

claim_map.claim: Weyl symbol isomorphism and ordered cocycle
claim_map.bridge: R=diag(-1,1); pi(Ru)=D_u; source omega(Ru,Rv)=sigma(u,v); use quotient-V normalization.

claim_map.claim: Fourier quadratic Weyl symbol and exact scalar
claim_map.bridge: kappa(w)=-w; quadratic phase=-||u||^2/4; standard complex C_N nu(w)=G_N/N. General primitive roots normalized directly by trace.

claim_map.claim: Exact ordered-pair rank 1 iff k=0 and N otherwise
claim_map.bridge: Remove product cocycle and diagonal phases; residual matrix is ones or row-permuted Fourier.

claim_map.claim: Minimum number of fixed-pair products equals tensor rank
claim_map.bridge: One product is an outer product after dephasing; rank decomposition constructs the converse.

claim_map.claim: Compatible direction classification and Fourier-equivalent factor
claim_map.bridge: Solve k=0 and calculate factor entries; O(N) endpoints only.
Nondegenerate trace pairing, completing square, Vandermonde rank.
Distinct tail nodes of a nonzero degree-d polynomial; invertible q(C), anisotropic generator and ordinary one-sided polynomial guards retained.

negative_boundary.meaning: Odd composite Fourier/Weil relation does not entail prime rank dichotomy.

disposition: Bounded primary-source mapping completed for fixed ordered-pair rank. Parent record and independent rational-degree attribution remain open; accepted proof and priority preserved.
